goals.0: The names of the seven days of the week
goals.1: am Montag, am Abend, um drei Uhr — which word when
goals.2: Giving a time span with von … bis …
dialog.1.de.3.n: am + day = on … (am Montag = on Monday)
dialog.4.de.3.n: For parts of the day use am: am Abend (in the evening), am Morgen (in the morning)
grammar.0.title: Wochentage — all der-words
grammar.0.note: The German week starts on Monday. “Every Monday”: montags.
grammar.2.text: Before days and parts of the day use am: am Montag, am Abend. Before clock times use um: um drei Uhr. For a range use von … bis …: von neun bis zwölf Uhr. They are three different words — practise putting them in the right place.
quiz.4.why: Before a day use am: Am Montag.
quiz.5.why: Before a clock time use um: um neun Uhr.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “From nine to twelve o'clock”
